name: Salmon Cakes with Mango Cabbage Slaw

cookwares.name: stainless steel or cast iron skillet

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ medium head napa cabbage
3 mangoes
3 limes
1 ½ small bunches cilantro

instructions.primary_message: Using a knife, shave the cilantro leaves off the stems at a downward angle, working away from your body; discard the stems and finely chop the leaves. Transfer ½ of the cilantro to a medium bowl (that will be used to mix the salmon mixture) and the other ½ to a large salad bowl.
Drain and add the salmon to the medium bowl with the cilantro.
instructions.secondary_message: 6 (213 g) cans wild pink salmon, traditional style

instructions.primary_message: Add the eggs, mayonnaise, Dijon, bread crumbs, salt, and pepper to the salmon and cilantro; mix together until well combined. Form the mixture into 12 patties and place on a plate.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 eggs
6 tbsp mayonnaise
3 tsp Dijon mustard
1 ½ cup panko bread crumbs
¾ tsp salt
⅜ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a skillet over medium heat.
While the skillet heats up, trim off and discard the root end of the cabbage; quarter the cabbage lengthwise, then thinly slice crosswise into shreds and add to the salad bowl.
Once the skillet is hot, add coconut oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Carefully place the salmon patties in the skillet; cook until golden brown, 3 to 5 minutes per side. Once done, transfer to a plate.
Peel the mangoes, then slice off the flesh from the pit, starting with the flatter sides; discard the pit and small dice the flesh (cut into 6-mm cubes). Add the mangoes to the salad bowl.
Juice the limes and add to the salad bowl.
Season the salad with salt and pepper; toss to coat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: To serve, place 2 salmon patties on a plate and add the mange cabbage slaw on the side. Enjoy!
